info.name: ControlOps Mobile — Staff / Client / Admin
info.description:
Mobile app API collection for Staff, Client, and Admin modules.

**Base URL:** `{{baseUrl}}` (default `https://controlops.co.uk/api`)

**Auth:** Bearer JWT from Auth → Login (token auto-saved).

Status tags:
- *(live)* — implemented on current backend
- *(planned)* — required by mobile spec; contract for app/backend

### Permission codes
| Code | Used by |
|------|--------|
| `portal.sites.read` | Staff, Client |
| `portal.rota.current` | Staff, Client |
| `portal.rota.upcoming` | Staff |
| `portal.rota.previous` | Staff |
| `portal.hours.read` | Staff, Client |
| `attend.read` / `attend.write` | Staff clock / attendance |
| `assign.read` / `assign.write` | OT / early finish |
| `staff_req.read` / `staff_req.write` | Client staff requests |
| `staff_req.review` | Admin/Controller approve/decline |
| `inv.read` | Client invoices |
| `incident.write` *(live)* | Staff/Client incidents |
| `portal.attendance.clock` *(planned)* | GPS clock in/out |
| `portal.invoice.query` *(planned)* | Client invoice comments |
| `staff_req.standdown` *(planned)* | Client cancel before approval |

item.name: 1.8 Lone Worker / Check Calls *(live)*
item.description: Lone working on the mobile app: start a session, answer the scheduled check call, raise assistance or SOS, and end the shift. Send `X-Client-App: mobile` so the audit trail records where each action came from. Poll `session/current` to drive the countdown.

request.description: Permission: `lone_worker.session_start`. Returns null when off duty. `display_status` is one of SESSION ACTIVE / SAFE / CHECK DUE / GRACE PERIOD / MISSED CHECK / ESCALATING / EMERGENCY / RESPONDER INVESTIGATING; `seconds_to_next_check` drives the countdown.
Permission: `lone_worker.session_start`. 409 if a session is already active. Check call rules are copied from the site policy onto the session.

Permission: `lone_worker.check_in`. Answers the open check and starts the next period. A confirmation after the grace period is recorded as a late check-in and leaves the incident open for a responder to close.
Permission: `lone_worker.sos`. Opens an incident and escalates immediately.
Permission: `lone_worker.sos`. Bypasses the check call window and grace period entirely — the incident opens at escalation level 1 straight away.
Permission: `lone_worker.session_start`. 409 while an incident is still open — a responder must resolve it first.

**PLANNED** — Matches mobile staff-request form.
site_type: Construction | Corporate | Hotels | Hospitals | Event | Other
staff_category: Static Guard | K9 Unit/Dog Handler | Housekeeping | Cleaners | Porters | Frontdesk/Receptionist | Mobile Patrol | Other
priority: urgent | normal
